Signal book

Alphabets where every letter is a picture: ship's flags, semaphore, ogham, braille shapes and tap code. No secret here, only the chart; the pleasure is in how they draw.

Starting points
Message
Alphabet
Colour

Heraldic hatching (the Petra Sancta system, 1638): red vertical lines, blue horizontal, yellow dotted, black crosshatched, white bare. A pen per colour writes one layer per colour for coloured pens.

Caption
Paper

drawing

Flags after the International Code of Signals; semaphore after the standard two-flag alphabet, drawn as seen by the reader; ogham after the twenty letters of the four aicmí; braille grade 1 cells. Normalizing and the optional classical ciphers come from UNRAVEL THE PURLOINED (commit dev).
